{{< video videos/rna_styles.mp4 >}}

Yeast tRNA (1EHZ) with the anticodon loop painted gold. The camera turns while the rest
     of the molecule fades, a callout names the loop, the base shape cuts from rectangles to
     cylinders, the cartoon cuts to B-factor colouring and finally to a surface.

     ProteinMotion writes the callout on with a vector animation and eases each residue's
     colour in turn; both are cuts here.

After ProteinMotion's [`rna_styles.py`](https://github.com/pdpppd/proteinmotion/blob/main/examples/rna_styles.py).

## Script

Run it with `uv run python docs/examples/timeline/scripts/rna_styles.py out_dir`; set
`MN_EXAMPLES_QUICK=1` for a small, fast check. The script is included from the file:

```{.python filename="scripts/rna_styles.py"}
{{< include scripts/rna_styles.py >}}
```
